Note::NlpAccessor::mask_hashtags¶

Back to Note NLP Accessor API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::NlpAccessor::mask_hashtags() const

Retain The Tag Role, Remove The Tag Value¶

mask_hashtags() replaces standalone hashtag tokens with [HASHTAG]. The token begins with #, contains one or more ASCII letters, digits, or underscores, and must not be immediately preceded by another ASCII word byte. That boundary recognizes tags after whitespace and punctuation while leaving embedded language tokens such as C# and mid#word unchanged.

The placeholder replaces only the #name span. Surrounding brackets, commas, parentheses, and slashes remain exactly where they were. A bare # has no tag body and is not matched. Non-ASCII tag characters terminate the recognized ASCII body rather than being decoded as part of it.

Use this operation when all tag values should collapse to one category. Use a token extractor when the actual tag identities are needed. The method accepts Text only, preserves every extent, returns a fresh packed Text Note, and never mutates the receiver. Empty and undefined behavior follows the normal Note transformation contract. [HASHTAG] is stable under repeated application.

Example 1: Start, Punctuation, And Embedded Boundaries¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::note::make({"#root (#ship); [#release_2] C# mid#word"})
        .nlp().mask_hashtags()) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[1], dim=1, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
["[HASHTAG] ([HASHTAG]); [[HASHTAG]] C# mid#word"]

Example 2: Empty, Undefined, And Bytes¶

const auto empty = pluss::note::make(std::vector<std::string>{})
                       .nlp().mask_hashtags();
std::cout << "hashtags empty dim=" << empty.dim()
          << " numel=" << empty.numel() << '\n';
std::cout << "hashtags undefined=" << std::boolalpha
          << pluss::Note::undefined().nlp().mask_hashtags().defined() << '\n';
try {
  (void)pluss::note::bytes(
      std::vector<std::string>{"#tag"}, std::array<std::int64_t, 1>{1})
      .nlp().mask_hashtags();
} catch (const pluss::Error&) { std::cout << "hashtags Bytes: rejected\n"; }

Output¶

hashtags empty dim=1 numel=0
hashtags undefined=false
hashtags Bytes: rejected
